star_cards.question: How do you systematically prevent hallucinations and evaluate accuracy in a production RAG pipeline?
star_cards.trap: Saying 'I tell the prompt to not lie'. Must discuss chunking, embeddings, re-ranking, and evals.
star_cards.model_defense: S: An internal enterprise knowledge assistant was generating 12% hallucinations on complex technical PDFs. T: Eliminate ungrounded answers and achieve >95% retrieval accuracy. A: Restructured the ingestion pipeline: chunked documents semantically by markdown headers rather than arbitrary character counts; implemented a hybrid search combining Pinecone dense vectors with BM25 sparse vectors, followed by a Cohere cross-encoder reranker. R: Slashed hallucination rate from 12% to 0.7% and improved user trust score to 98%.

star_cards.trap: Reciting formal mathematical definitions without intuition.
star_cards.model_defense: S: Executive leadership wanted to roll out a new landing page after 3 days because it showed a 10% lift. star_cards.trap: Only talking about increasing cluster size without fixing data skew or partitions.
star_cards.model_defense: S: Our nightly financial reconciliation Spark job was taking 7.5 hours and frequently breaching its 8:00 AM SLA. T: Reduce runtime to under 2 hours to ensure downstream regulatory compliance. star_cards.trap: Reciting formal mathematical definitions without intuition.
star_cards.model_defense: S: Executive leadership wanted to roll out a new landing page after 3 days because it showed a 10% lift. R: The full test revealed no real lift, saving the company from making an expensive mistake that would have degraded SEO.

star_cards.question: How do you systematically prevent hallucinations and evaluate accuracy in a production RAG pipeline?
star_cards.trap: Saying 'I tell the prompt to not lie'. Must discuss chunking, embeddings, re-ranking, and evals.
star_cards.model_defense: S: An internal enterprise knowledge assistant was generating 12% hallucinations on complex technical PDFs. T: Eliminate ungrounded answers and achieve >95% retrieval accuracy. A: Restructured the ingestion pipeline: chunked documents semantically by markdown headers rather than arbitrary character counts; implemented a hybrid search combining Pinecone dense vectors with BM25 sparse vectors, followed by a Cohere cross-encoder reranker. Added an automated evaluation loop with Ragas tracking context recall and answer faithfulness, and enforced strict citation grounding in the prompt with fallback to human review when confidence < 0.85. R: Slashed hallucination rate from 12% to 0.7% and improved user trust score to 98%.
